earnings.title: Corpay Reports Third Quarter Financial Results
highlights: 18% revenue growth, 11% organic revenue growth, and 32% adjusted EPS growth
Revenues increased 18% to $1,381.9 million in the third quarter of 2026, compared with $1,172.5 million in the third quarter of 2025.
Net income 2 increased 36% to $378.4 million in the third quarter of 2026, compared with $277.9 million in the third quarter of 2025.
Net income per diluted share 2 increased 45% to $5.66 in the third quarter of 2026, compared with $3.91 per diluted share in the third quarter of 2025.
Adjusted net income 1,2 increased 24% to $500.7 million in the third quarter of 2026, compared with $405.2 million in the third quarter of 2025.

quotes.text: Our third quarter results were excellent, with revenue growth of 18% and adjusted net income per diluted share growth of 32%, both ahead of our expectations.
quotes.by: Ron Clarke, chairman and chief executive officer, Corpay, Inc

quotes.text: Corporate Payments delivered 18% organic revenue growth driven by strong performance in both spend management and cross-border, and we delivered 57.4% EBITDA margins due to the high flow through rate on revenue.
quotes.by: Peter Walker, chief financial officer, Corpay, Inc

outlook: Weighted average U.S. fuel prices equal to $4.90 per gallon for the rest of the year, based on the October 2026 EIA short-term energy outlook;
